decisions.reason: As a flagship product with repeated gold-award recognition in 2023 and 2024, its value has resolved positively and the firm is very unlikely to withdraw it.
This bread fits the firm's core bakery capabilities and has stayed on the website across both years, so with low carrying costs and no clear negative signal it remains worth keeping.
This stollen is close to the established seasonal offer and has remained actively presented, so despite some assortment-rationalization risk the option value still favors keeping it on the market.
